satoshi.text: Sunday dispatch: BTC-EUR flat into Friday's close at €63,999 while the alt bench bled — SOL -1.2%, BCH -1.4%, AVAX -1.3%. Dominance grinding up is not a markup-ending tell, it's a markup-continuing one. Core sleeve (25% BTC / 15% ETH / 7.5% SOL) stays put.

No trades today. Round-trip cost on Kraken spot is 0.52% — weekend noise rarely clears that hurdle. F&G nowhere near euphoria, halving-cycle clock still reads late markup. I'll spend the gas on Monday when the EU open gives me something real to price.
